CommunityApplications.Profile:
**WooSarr** is a Plex user and library management system with Seerr integration for media requests, driven by your Discord server.
Map Discord roles to Plex libraries: members get every library their roles give, and losing a role only removes a library if nothing else keeps it. Members link their Plex account themselves with `/link` (verified by signing in with Plex), admins link anyone, and families can share one Plex account. Invite people to Plex with `/invite`, give roles through reaction posts, add custom emoji to your server, and let members request movies and shows through Seerr with `/request`. Mass library and role changes, exemptions, and manual grants are in the web UI. WooSarr starts in dry-run, previews the impact of every change, and keeps a full audit trail.
One container, web UI on port 31337. Setup and documentation: https://github.com/WoosArr/woosarr. Questions and bugs: https://github.com/WoosArr/woosarr/issues.
